rationale: Both Sameer and Sumedh are focused on robotics, but from complementary angles—Sameer brings production ML engineering experience from CVS Health, while Sumedh is doing cutting-edge research on embodied AI and robotic manipulation at Amazon Frontier AI, with published work on vision-language models and reinforcement learning. They could exchange perspectives on moving robotics research from the lab into real systems, and explore how multimodal learning approaches might apply to production robotic applications.
intro_message: Sameer Shah, meet Sumedh Sontakke — you both work in robotics, but Sumedh's research on vision-language models and manipulation at Amazon could be particularly relevant to your ML systems work, and your production experience could offer him grounding on real-world deployment challenges.
